questions.q: A relation R is defined on N. Which of the following is the reflexive relation?
options: R = [(x, y) : x > y, x, y ∈ N]
R = [(x, y) : xy is the square number, x, y ∈ N]
questions.explain: R = [(x, y) : xy is the square number, x, y ∈ N] A relation R is reflexive if every element is related to itself, i.e., (x,x)∈R for all x∈N. In option (a), x>y cannot hold for x=y, so it is not reflexive.
